faq.q: How does the process work, from first contact to delivery?
faq.a: We start with a free assessment to understand your business. Then you get scope, timeline and price in writing, with no commitment. Development happens in short cycles with demos of what's already working, and at the end we hand over the code, access and documentation.

faq.q: How much does a project cost?
faq.a: It depends on what the project needs. A simple landing page costs far less than an online store or a management system. That's why we start with the smallest scope that solves your problem and give you the price in writing before any code.

As a reference: landing page, 1 to 3 weeks; institutional website, 3 to 6; digital catalog, 3 to 5; online store, 6 to 12; management system, 8 to 16. Custom software gets its timeline after the assessment.

faq.q: Do the project and the code stay with me?
faq.a: Yes. At the end of the project you receive the repository, access and documentation. We use popular technologies, so other professionals can maintain it if you ever need that.
Yes. 90 days of support and fixes are included at no extra cost. After that, we can keep evolving the project together.

faq.q: Do you work with clients in other cities?
faq.a: Yes. We're based in Manaus and work remotely with companies and professionals across Brazil, over WhatsApp, email and video calls.

faq.q: How do I request a quote?
faq.a: Fill out the contact form or message us on WhatsApp. We reply within 24 business hours, with follow-up questions or already with a proposal.

about.pageTitle: We're the technical team your company doesn't need to hire yet.
about.paragraph1: Raccoon Technology was born from a simple frustration: good businesses losing time and money on software that's poorly built, poorly explained, and expensive to maintain.
about.paragraph2: We work on custom development — from the institutional website that needs to convey credibility to the internal system that organizes inventory, orders, and staff. We mainly serve companies, but also professionals and individuals with well-defined projects.
about.paragraph3: Our way of working is direct: we understand the process, propose the smallest scope that solves it, deliver in short cycles, and show it working. You follow progress without needing to know what a deploy is.
about.paragraph4: The raccoon with glasses isn't there by accident. Raccoons are curious, adaptable, and solve problems with whatever they have on hand — that's exactly how we approach every project.
about.curiousText: Every project starts with questions — lots of them — before the first line of code.
about.valor1p: Every business has its own process. We adjust the solution, not how you work.
about.valor2p: Progress, risks, and technical decisions are always open to you.
about.valor3p: We'd rather deliver something working in weeks than promise perfection in months.
about.closingTitle: Tell us your challenge. We'll hand back a plan.
about.paragraphLocation: We're based in Manaus, in Brazil's Amazonas state, and work remotely with companies and professionals across the country.

privacy.intro: This policy explains how Raccoon Technology handles personal data submitted through this website, in line with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018, the LGPD).

sections.title: Who is the controller
paragraphs: The data controller is Raccoon Technology. For anything related to this policy, write to contato@raccoontechnology.com.br.

sections.title: What data we collect
paragraphs: We only collect what you enter in the contact form: name, email, phone or WhatsApp (optional), project type, expected budget, desired timeline and your message.
We don't ask for ID documents, financial data or sensitive personal data.

sections.title: What we use it for
paragraphs: We use this data to reply to you, prepare proposals and move forward with conversations you started. We don't sell your data and don't use it to send third-party advertising.

sections.title: Legal basis
paragraphs: Processing is based on your consent when you submit the form and on preliminary procedures related to a contract, at the data subject's request (art. 7, items I and V, of the LGPD).

sections.title: Who we share it with
paragraphs: To run the site we use providers that process data on our behalf: Resend, which delivers the message you send by email, and Vercel, which hosts the site.
If you choose to talk on WhatsApp, the conversation is also governed by WhatsApp/Meta's terms.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep your messages for as long as needed to handle your request and to meet legal or regulatory obligations.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask at any time for confirmation that we process your data, access, correction, anonymization or deletion, portability, information about sharing, and withdrawal of consent (art. 18 of the LGPD).

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: This site only uses the cookie needed to remember the language you chose. If we start using analytics or advertising tools, this policy will be updated.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: We may update this policy. The date of the last update is always shown at the top of this page.
